compendium.name: Blast
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 power points/level · **Range** 100m

Ranged attack: 1D6 points of magical damage per level. Non-magical armor absorbs the damage as normal, and it can be dodged or parried with a shield (which takes the damage). Countermagic can stop it; Protection and Resistance do not work against it.

compendium.name: Change
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level · **Range** 30m · **Duration** 15 minutes

Transforms a willing target (or one whose POW is overcome in a resistance roll) into another creature/object of the same relative type (animal/vegetable/mineral). Each level affects 3 SIZ; characteristics remain unchanged, only outward form/abilities change.

compendium.name: Conjure (type) Elemental
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level per point of elemental POW · **Range** 12m · **Duration** 10 combat rounds

Summons or dismisses one of the four elemental types (Air, Earth, Fire, Water). The elemental must be directed by the magician’s full attention for the duration.

compendium.name: Control
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 power points/level · **Range** 100m · **Duration** 10 combat rounds

Controls the thoughts/actions of one intelligent being per level (POW vs. POW resistance roll; cannot target unintelligent animals). The magician must concentrate, or the target stands idle.

compendium.name: Countermagic
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Reflects an incoming spell of equal or lower level back at its caster.

compendium.name: Dark
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Fills an area with darkness, 3 SIZ per level.

compendium.name: Diminish
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Reduces one of the target’s characteristics by 1 point per level (resistance roll if unwilling).

compendium.name: Dispel
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Eliminates existing spell effects of equal or lower level; may banish supernatural beings.

compendium.name: Dull
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Reduces a weapon’s attack chance and damage.

compendium.name: Enhance
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Increases one of the target’s characteristics by 1 point per level.

compendium.name: Fire
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 power points/level · **Range** 100m

Ranged attack: 1D6 points of fire damage per level.

compendium.name: Frost
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 power points/level · **Range** 100m

Ranged attack: 1D6 points of frost damage per level.

compendium.name: Heal
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 power points/level

Heals 1D6 points of damage per level.

compendium.name: Illusion
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Creates a visual/audible illusion covering 3 SIZ per level.

compendium.name: Invisibility
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Makes 3 SIZ points of an object or person invisible per level.

compendium.name: Lift
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Lifts and moves 3 SIZ points of an object or person per level.

compendium.name: Light
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Fills an area with light, 3 SIZ per level.

compendium.name: Lightning
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 power points/level · **Range** 100m

Ranged attack: 1D6 points of lightning damage per level.

compendium.name: Perception
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Allows the magician to detect one specific thing within range.

compendium.name: Protection
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Adds 1 point of armor value per level against physical attacks.

compendium.name: Resistance
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Reduces damage from heat and/or cold by 1 point per level.

compendium.name: Seal
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Joins two inanimate objects together.

compendium.name: Sharpen
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Increases a weapon’s attack chance and damage.

compendium.name: Speak to Mind
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Allows mental communication between the magician and a target.

compendium.name: Teleport
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Teleports 3 SIZ points per level anywhere within range.

compendium.name: Unseal
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Separates two objects joined by Seal (or similar).

compendium.name: Vision
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Allows the magician to see what is happening elsewhere, or in the past.

compendium.name: Wall
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Creates a barrier of 3 SIZ per level to protect the caster.

compendium.name: Ward
compendium.body:
**Cost** 1 power point/level

Defines an area automatically protected by Blast and Countermagic.

compendium.name: Wounding
compendium.body:
**Cost** 3 power points/level

Causes 1D6 points of damage per level (touch attack).

compendium.name: Adaptability
compendium.body:
**Roll** 01-03

Instantly adjusts to (or ignores) one chosen extreme condition; the relevant characteristic is doubled on a resistance roll against it.

compendium.name: Allergy (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 04-05

Hypersensitive to a chosen substance: minor gives −20% to all skills on contact and for 15 minutes after; major deals 1D6 damage per exposure (armor doesn’t help) plus −40% to all skills.

compendium.name: Biped (Quadruped) (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 06-09

Forces a four-legged stance instead of two-legged; minor can stand upright for CON rounds, major needs an Agility roll each round upright.

compendium.name: Camouflage
compendium.body:
**Roll** 10-12

Unnatural coloration or texture; +20% to Hide (minor) or +40% and can actively change to match surroundings (major).

compendium.name: Coloration (Minor)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 13-15

Strikingly unnatural skin/scale/fur coloration — cosmetic only.

compendium.name: Congenital Disease (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 16-19

An incurable non-contagious ailment reduces one characteristic (minor) or two (major) by 1D6 points each.

compendium.name: Decreased Characteristic (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 20-22

Reduces a randomly determined characteristic by 1D6 (minor) or 2D6 (major), never below 1.

compendium.name: Disease Carrier (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 23-25

Carries (but is immune to) a disease of POT 2D10 (minor) or 4D10/two diseases (major); exposed targets resist CON vs. POT or contract it.

compendium.name: Group Intelligence
compendium.body:
**Roll** 26-29

Part of a hive mind sharing sensation (minor, CON meters range) or full telepathic communication at unlimited range (major).

compendium.name: Hands
compendium.body:
**Roll** 30

Extra prehensile limb(s) — a tail, extra hands, or similar — usable as an additional limb in combat or tasks; may allow an extra action.

compendium.name: Hardy
compendium.body:
**Roll** 31-33

Halves damage from one chosen damage type (minor); major also lets the mutant keep acting below 0 HP down to a negative threshold.

compendium.name: Hybrid
compendium.body:
**Roll** 34-35

Has one animalistic trait (fur, tail, scales, etc.), cosmetic or minor mechanical benefit.

compendium.name: Imitation
compendium.body:
**Roll** 36-37

Imitates an animal’s natural trait (a bird’s call, a chameleon’s color-change, etc.).

compendium.name: Increased Characteristic
compendium.body:
**Roll** 38-44

Increases a randomly determined characteristic by 1D6 (minor) or 2D6 (major).

compendium.name: Keen Sense
compendium.body:
**Roll** 45-48

One or more senses become extraordinarily sharp, granting a bonus to related perception skills.

compendium.name: Luminescence
compendium.body:
**Roll** 49-50

Emits light from the body, from a dim glow to enough to read by.

compendium.name: Metabolic Improvement
compendium.body:
**Roll** 51-53

An unusual but beneficial metabolism — e.g. faster healing, reduced need for food/sleep.

compendium.name: Metabolic Weakness (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 54-57

An unusual, disadvantageous metabolism — e.g. must eat constantly, vulnerable to a common substance.

compendium.name: Natural Armor
compendium.body:
**Roll** 58-60

Grants natural armor (scales, horn, thick hide, etc.) — points of protection scaling with minor/major.

compendium.name: Natural Weaponry
compendium.body:
**Roll** 61-65

Grows a natural weapon (spine, claw, teeth, stinger) usable as a Brawl attack, dealing extra damage.

compendium.name: Pain Sensitivity (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 66-67

Unusually low pain tolerance — actions become Difficult while injured (minor) or major wounds incapacitate automatically (major).

compendium.name: Pheromone
compendium.body:
**Roll** 68

Emits chemicals that affect the emotional state or behavior of others nearby.

compendium.name: Reduced Sense (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 69-70

A primary sense is impaired (minor) or missing entirely (major).

compendium.name: Regeneration
compendium.body:
**Roll** 71-72

Heals lost hit points at an accelerated rate each combat round.

compendium.name: Sensitivity
compendium.body:
**Roll** 73-74

An unusual physiological affinity — positive or negative — for a specific substance (blood, silver, sunlight, etc.).

compendium.name: Speech (Mimicry)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 75-76

Can imitate animal noises (minor) or speak clearly despite non-human anatomy (major).

compendium.name: Structural Improvement
compendium.body:
**Roll** 77-81

An unusual, beneficial body structure — e.g. extra load-bearing limbs, an armored carapace.

compendium.name: Structural Weakness (Adverse)
compendium.body:
**Roll** 82-86

An unusual, disadvantageous body structure — e.g. brittle bones, a vulnerable exposed organ.

compendium.name: Venom
compendium.body:
**Roll** 87-89

Secretes a natural poison delivered by bite, sting, or touch (see Poisons, p.151).

compendium.name: Wings
compendium.body:
**Roll** 90

Grows wings sufficient to glide (minor) or fly under its own power (major).

compendium.name: Astral Projection
compendium.body: Leave the physical body and travel in psychic form.

compendium.name: Aura Detection
compendium.body: Perceive the aura emanated by a living being.

compendium.name: Clairvoyance
compendium.body: Project awareness into another place.

compendium.name: Cryokinesis
compendium.body: Create an area of intense cold on an area, object, or target.

compendium.name: Danger Sense
compendium.body: Detect danger from other characters or a situation before it manifests.

compendium.name: Dead Calm
compendium.body: Resist mental shock or delay the effects of sanity loss.

compendium.name: Divination
compendium.body: Ask a higher power for guidance and insight.

compendium.name: Eidetic Memory
compendium.body: Perfect and total recall of previous experiences.

compendium.name: Emotion Control
compendium.body: Affect the emotional state of a target or targets.

compendium.name: Empathy
compendium.body: Detect the inner feelings of a target or targets.

compendium.name: Intuition
compendium.body: Detect a certain person or class of item.

compendium.name: Levitation
compendium.body: Floating movement above the ground.

compendium.name: Mind Blast
compendium.body: A direct psychic attack against a target (power point vs. power point or POW vs. POW).

compendium.name: Mind Control
compendium.body: Control the physical body and will of a target (POW vs. POW resistance roll).

compendium.name: Mind Shield
compendium.body: Protection against psychic interference and attacks; each point spent resists power points used against the psychic.

compendium.name: Precognition
compendium.body: A brief, intuitive glimpse into the future — more power points spent reaches further ahead.

compendium.name: Psychometry
compendium.body: ‘Read’ past emotions and events associated with an object or place by touch.

compendium.name: Pyrokinesis
compendium.body: Heat an area, object, or target to extreme temperatures; 1D6 damage per 3 power points spent.

compendium.name: Sensitivity (Psychic Ability)
compendium.body: Detect supernatural or spiritual emanations, or the recent use of psychic abilities, in an area.

compendium.name: Telekinesis
compendium.body: Manipulate and move objects mentally at a distance.

compendium.name: Telepathy
compendium.body: Read minds, or speak mind-to-mind with a target.

compendium.name: Cloak of Night
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4 · **Range** Touch/Sight

Augmentation. Adds +20% per level to Hide, cumulative for the duration.

compendium.name: Leap (Sorcery)
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Augmentation. Adds +20% per level to Jump.

compendium.name: Sureness
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Augmentation. Adds +20% per level to Stealth.

compendium.name: Bolster the Soul
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 3 points per level to POW for the duration.

compendium.name: Inhuman Plasticity
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 3 points per level to SIZ for the duration.

compendium.name: Lightning Speed
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 1 point per level to MOV for the duration.

compendium.name: Relentless Vitality
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 3 points per level to CON for the duration.

compendium.name: Suppleness of the Serpent
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 3 points per level to DEX for the duration.

compendium.name: Titan’s Strength
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 3 points per level to STR for the duration.

compendium.name: Unearthly Beauty
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 3 points per level to CHA for the duration.

compendium.name: Wisdom of the Sage
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-3

Characteristic. Adds 3 points per level to INT for the duration.

compendium.name: Hammer of the Gods
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Combat. Adds 1 point of damage per level to blunt weapons.

compendium.name: Hell’s Razor
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Combat. Adds 1 point of damage per level to cutting weapons.

compendium.name: Sorcery’s Sharp Flame
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Combat. Adds 1 point of damage per level to impaling weapons.

compendium.name: Sorcerous Armor
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Combat. Adds 1 point of armor per level.

compendium.name: Talons of the Beast
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Combat. Adds 1 point of damage per level to unarmed/Brawl attacks.

compendium.name: Unbreakable Bulwark
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Combat. Adds 1 point of armor per level to shields.

compendium.name: Make Fast
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Enhancement. Glues together two inanimate objects.

compendium.name: Make Whole
compendium.body:
**Level** 3

Enhancement. Repairs a broken item.

compendium.name: Midnight
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Enhancement. Creates an area of darkness.

compendium.name: Moonrise
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Enhancement. Creates a floating globe of light.

compendium.name: Bounty of the Sea
compendium.body:
**Level** 4

Elemental. Fills an area with water.

compendium.name: Fires of the Sun
compendium.body:
**Level** 4 · **Range** Sight

Elemental. A floating, fueless mass of fire hangs in view, about 3m across, igniting adjacent materials for 1D6+2 fire damage/round. Must be known before fire elementals can be summoned. Negated by Wings of the Sky; dispelled by a 4-point Undo Sorcery.

compendium.name: Gift of the Earth
compendium.body:
**Level** 4

Elemental. Fills an area with dirt.

compendium.name: Wings of the Sky
compendium.body:
**Level** 4

Elemental. Fills an area with wind.

compendium.name: Curse of Sorcery
compendium.body:
**Level** 4 · **Range** Touch

Manipulative. On a successful POW vs. POW roll, disfigures part of the target’s body with a gruesome/demonic quality (cosmetic; a second success gives it a monstrous shape). May cost 1D3 CHA if visible. Lasts until the caster dies; can’t be recast on the same target while active.

compendium.name: Fury
compendium.body:
**Level** 1 · **Range** Touch

Manipulative. Induces a berserk rage (power point vs. power point if unwilling): the target fights unceasingly for the duration and gets one extra attack per round.

compendium.name: Inescapable Bonds
compendium.body:
**Level** 3

Manipulative. Immobilizes the target; resistance roll to resist.

compendium.name: Liken Shape
compendium.body:
**Level** 4

Manipulative. Assume the image/appearance of another person.

compendium.name: Muddle
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Manipulative. Disorients the target.

compendium.name: Pox
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Manipulative. Reduces the target’s power points; resistance roll to resist.

compendium.name: Brazier of Power
compendium.body:
**Level** 4

Occult. Creates a reservoir of power points other sorcerers can draw from.

compendium.name: Chain of Being
compendium.body:
**Level** 4

Occult. Creates a shared pool of power points.

compendium.name: Undo Sorcery
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Occult. Cancels various sorcery spells of equal or lower level (unless protected by Refutation).

compendium.name: Ward (Sorcery)
compendium.body:
**Level** 3

Occult. Creates a magical alarm over an area.

compendium.name: Summon Demon
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Summoning. Summons a demon (see Chapter 11: Creatures).

compendium.name: Summon Elemental
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Summoning. Summons an elemental (see Chapter 11: Creatures) — requires the matching elemental spell already known.

compendium.name: Bird’s Vision
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Utility. Controls a bird and sees through its eyes.

compendium.name: Breath of Life
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Utility. Provides breathable air underwater or in another hostile environment.

compendium.name: Farsight
compendium.body:
**Level** 1 · **Range** Sight

Utility. Doubles the closeness of anything seen; repeated castings while active cumulatively double it further.

compendium.name: Heal (Sorcery)
compendium.body:
**Level** 2

Utility. Restores lost hit points.

compendium.name: Keen Ear
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Utility. Carries spoken words across great distances.

compendium.name: Refutation
compendium.body:
**Levels** 1-4

Utility. Protects a spell against being cancelled by Undo Sorcery.

compendium.name: Vermin’s Vision
compendium.body:
**Level** 1

Utility. Controls vermin and sees through their eyes.

compendium.name: Witch Sight
compendium.body:
**Level** 3

Utility. Determines a target’s POW.

compendium.name: Absorption
compendium.body: Absorb energy of a chosen type from an attack and turn it into power points; armor reduces the damage before Absorption applies.

compendium.name: Adaptation
compendium.body: Each level allows comfortable survival in one hostile environment (cold, heat, vacuum, high pressure, radiation, etc.).

compendium.name: Alternate Form
compendium.body: Each level is an alternate body the character can switch into.

compendium.name: Armor (Superpower)
compendium.body: Each level provides 1 point of protection against a specific chosen energy type.

compendium.name: Barrier
compendium.body: Each level creates a 1-meter-square section of protective wall.

compendium.name: Defense
compendium.body: Lowers the character’s chance to be hit by −1% per level.

compendium.name: Density Control
compendium.body: Each level adds or subtracts 1 point of density (SIZ), without changing mass/volume proportionally.

compendium.name: Diminish/Enhance Characteristic
compendium.body: Lowers or increases a target characteristic by 1D6 per level.

compendium.name: Drain
compendium.body: Each level drains 1 hit point, power point, fatigue point, or sanity point from a target, usually transferred to the user.

compendium.name: Energy Control
compendium.body: Allows creation of and control over a specific type of energy (fire, cold, electricity, etc.), aside from direct damage.

compendium.name: Energy Projection
compendium.body: Allows projection of a focused, damaging beam of a specific energy type.

compendium.name: Extra Energy
compendium.body: Each level provides +10 additional power points.

compendium.name: Extra Hit Points
compendium.body: Each level provides +1 additional hit point.

compendium.name: Flight
compendium.body: Each level allows self-powered flight for 1 SIZ point of the character.

compendium.name: Force Field
compendium.body: Each level offers 1 point of protection against a specific type of energy, as an external field rather than worn armor.

compendium.name: Intangibility
compendium.body: Allows the character to move through solid objects.

compendium.name: Invisibility (Superpower)
compendium.body: Each level turns 1 SIZ point of the character (or another target) invisible.

compendium.name: Leap
compendium.body: Adds to the character’s normal jumping distance, horizontally and vertically.

compendium.name: Protection (Superpower)
compendium.body: Each level reduces the effective level/potency of an attacking energy type.

compendium.name: Regeneration (Superpower)
compendium.body: Each level returns 1 lost hit point per combat round.

compendium.name: Resistance (Superpower)
compendium.body: Each level resists 1 point of damage from a single specific energy type.

compendium.name: Sidekick
compendium.body: A loyal associated nonplayer character who accompanies and assists the hero.

compendium.name: Size Change
compendium.body: Each level adds or subtracts 1 point of SIZ, proportionally affecting mass and reach.

compendium.name: Snare Projection
compendium.body: Each level is 1 STR and/or SIZ of a projected net, web, rope, or other confining snare.

compendium.name: Stretching
compendium.body: Stretch the body into different sizes and shapes, extending reach or squeezing through gaps.

compendium.name: Super Characteristic
compendium.body: Extra points in STR, CON, SIZ, INT, POW, DEX, CHA, or EDU, purchased per point.

compendium.name: Super Movement
compendium.body: Each type grants a unique method of movement (wall-crawling, water-walking, burrowing, etc.).

compendium.name: Super Sense
compendium.body: Each type improves an existing sense or adds an extraordinary aspect to it (dark vision, infrared vision, super hearing, etc.).

compendium.name: Super Skill
compendium.body: Each level adds +20% to one specific skill.

compendium.name: Super Speed
compendium.body: Each level adds an additional action or movement each combat round.

compendium.name: Teleport (Superpower)
compendium.body: Each level allows instantaneous teleportation of 1 SIZ point of an object or target (including the user).

compendium.name: Transfer
compendium.body: Each level allows transfer of 1 hit point, power point, fatigue point, or sanity point to a target.

compendium.name: Unarmed Combat
compendium.body: Increases ability in unarmed combat — bonus damage, a skill bonus, and/or a chance to reduce an opponent’s hit chance.

compendium.name: Weather Control
compendium.body: Alters or creates weather conditions in an area.

compendium.body: Advanced dermal regenerators, hypo-sprays, clotting agents, and a simple medical scanner. Makes First Aid attempts Easy and doubles hit points healed. Expensive.

compendium.name: Auto-doc
compendium.body: A fully automated medical treatment system with 100% Medicine and First Aid, doubling hit points restored and halving recovery time. Expensive to Priceless.

compendium.name: Chemistry Set

compendium.name: Computer
compendium.body: Aids Appraise, Art, Gaming, Knowledge, Science, Teach, and especially Research: up to +20% if suitable for the skill, none for an average setup, up to −20% for an inferior one.

compendium.name: Criminology Kit
compendium.body: Fingerprint and trace-evidence tools: collection bags, magnifying glasses, chemicals, black-light and normal flashlights. Expensive.

compendium.name: Disguise Kit
compendium.body: Skin dyes, makeup, wigs, false teeth/hair, and styling tools to change appearance. Cheap to Average commercially, Expensive if high-quality.

compendium.name: Lockpicks
compendium.body: From a few single picks to a sophisticated set with stethoscope and drills for opening locks. Cheap to Expensive.

compendium.name: Suppressor / Silencer
compendium.body: Muffles a firearm’s report but halves its base range; wears out after 1D100+10 shots. Cannot fit a shotgun or heavy machine gun. Expensive and often Restricted.

compendium.name: Telescopic Scope / Laser Sight
compendium.body: A scope doubles a firearm’s base range; a laser sight quadruples it. Especially effective with Aimed Attacks. Average value (precision scopes may be Expensive).

monsters.skillsText: Climb 75%, Search 75%, Swim 75%

monsters.name: Shark
monsters.desc: If its bite misses or is dodged, it attempts a fin slash 5 DEX ranks later. After a hit, some sharks keep biting and thrashing round after round.
monsters.skillsText: Sense 95%, Swim 100%

monsters.name: Snake (Constrictor)
monsters.desc: Bites, then attempts to constrict 5 DEX ranks later. A constricted target takes chest damage each round and must break free with a STR resistance roll.
monsters.skillsText: Climb 85%, Dodge 60%, Hide 75%, Sense 75%, Stealth 90%, Swim 70%

monsters.name: Snake (Venomous)
monsters.desc: A venomous snake; see Poisons (p.151) for potency by species.
monsters.skillsText: Climb 50%, Dodge 50%, Hide 80%, Sense 65%, Stealth 90%, Swim 70%

monsters.name: Squid (Giant)
monsters.desc: Can attack up to five targets simultaneously with its beak and ten tentacles; a second tentacle latching onto a target begins constriction. Its poison POT equals its CON.
monsters.skillsText: Hide 70%, Swim 100%

monsters.name: Tiger
monsters.desc: Makes two simultaneous claws and a bite (5 DEX ranks later); if both claws hit, it hangs on and rips with hind claws next round.
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 45%, Hide 80%, Jump 55%, Stealth 75%, Sense 70%, Track 50%

monsters.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
monsters.desc: Bites first, then 5 DEX ranks later seizes with both foreclaws (substituted for a kick against larger targets), sometimes climbing onto prey to bite and kick.
monsters.skillsText: Jump 50%, Listen 45%, Sense 35%, Spot 50%, Track 50%

monsters.name: Wolf
monsters.desc: Hunts in packs of a dozen to 40 or more, fighting cooperatively; a large wolf may try to knock a target prone so the pack can tear at it.
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 35%, Listen 75%, Sense 90%, Spot 60%, Track 80%

monsters.name: Centaur
monsters.desc: Half-human, half-horse. Wise and pastoral, keepers of lore, fine craftsmen, musicians, and warriors; freely intermingle with humans.
monsters.attacksText: Composite Bow 45%, 1D8+1+½dm; Lance 35%, 1D10+1+dm; Bastard Sword 40%, 1D10+1+dm; Target Shield 50%, 1D2+dm; Kick 50%, 1D6+dm; Rear and Plunge 35%, 2D8+dm; Trample 25%, 2D6+dm
monsters.skillsText: Appraise 50%, Bargain 35%, Command 25%, Dodge 35%, Etiquette 35%, Insight 40%, First Aid 40%, Jump 60%, Knowledge (History) 50%, Listen 35%, Perform (Lyre) 35%, Sense 50%, Spot 40%, Swim 35%, Track 25%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Kicks 5 DEX ranks after a melee weapon strike; melee damage modifier uses STR×2 (normal for kicks/trample/charge). Prefers magic to sorcery: Enhance 35%, Heal 60%, Illusion 45%, Perception 40%, Vision 50%.

monsters.name: Dragon
monsters.desc: Gigantic, flame-breathing flying reptiles with armored hides; solitary hoarders. Some are intelligent, most are cunning beasts. This represents a bestial dragon.
monsters.skillsText: Climb 65%, Dodge 55%, First Aid 45%, Hide 35%, Jump 45%, Sense 30%, Spot 45%, Stealth 45%, Swim 35%, Track 40%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Fire covers a 3m area at range equal to POW in meters; costs 1D6 power/fatigue points to breathe and can ignite targets. On the ground, makes two attacks a round (bite or breathe, plus claw or tail 5 DEX ranks later); tail sweep is an area attack. Intelligent dragons (INT 4D6) know magic or sorcery and may have other breath weapons.

monsters.name: Dwarf
monsters.desc: Traditionally live underground; famed for short tempers, fine craftsmanship, ancient grudges, excessive drinking, and long beards.
monsters.skillsText: Appraise 50%, Bargain 45%, Brawl 50%, Craft (blacksmithing) 45%, Dodge 40%, Grapple 45%, Knowledge (Dwarf-lore) 35%, Language (Human) 35%, Language (Dwarf) 65%, Listen 45%, Repair (weapons and armor) 35%, Spot 45%, Status 35%, Throw 35%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Traditionally shun magic, though some use magic or sorcery. Natural Super Sense (Dark Vision) with levels equal to half POW (round up).

monsters.name: Elf
monsters.desc: Traditionally forest dwellers with a strong connection to nature; long-lived, aloof, and mysterious. Half-elves average both parents’ characteristics.
monsters.attacksText: Longbow 55%, 1D8+1+½dm; Short Sword 45%, 1D6+1+dm; Short Spear 40%, 1D6+1+dm; Short Spear (thrown) 55%, 1D6+1+½dm
monsters.skillsText: Climb 65%, Dodge 55%, First Aid 45%, Hide 35%, Jump 45%, Knowledge (Elf-lore) 45%, Language (Human) 40%, Language (Elvish) 85%, Listen 55%, Perform (Sing) 35%, Sense 30%, Spot 45%, Stealth 45%, Swim 35%, Track 40%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Commonly use magic; natural Super Sense (Night Vision) at half POW (round up). Common magic: Dispel 45%, Heal 50%, Illusion 35%, Perception 60%, Resistance 50%, Vision 60%.

monsters.name: Ghost
monsters.desc: The spiritual remnant of a living being, attached to a place, object, or person, usually tied to its death. Frequently insane and driven to right some past wrong.
monsters.attacksText: Ghostly Combat, POW vs. POW, 1D3 power points
monsters.skillsText: As appropriate.

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Ghostly combat is a POW vs. POW roll; the loser drains 1D3 power points (some ghosts drain more, or inflict HP damage instead). A ghost reduced to 0 power points may possess the target. Immaterial — not subject to the Intangibility superpower’s limits. May have other powers suited to its former life: psychic powers (Cryokinesis, Mind Blast, Mind Control, Pyrokinesis, Telekinesis) or superpowers (Drain, Energy Control, Invisibility, Teleport, Weather Control).

monsters.name: Ghoul
monsters.desc: Hideously deformed humans who feed on the dead, caught between life and death; bestial and barely intelligent. Formed when a malignant spirit possesses a fresh corpse.
monsters.skillsText: Climb 60%, Dodge 45%, Grapple 50%, Hide 35%, Jump 50%, Listen 60%, Sense 40%, Spot 50%, Stealth 60%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Bite injects venom (POT = CON); enough accumulated POT paralyzes the target for days equal to their CON. Howl (½ CON meters, round up) is a POW vs. INT roll that stuns failing targets until the howling stops; costs 1 power point. Natural Super Sense (Night Vision) at half INT (round up). More intelligent ghouls may know sorcery. Gains power points by eating corpses (1 per 3 SIZ) and must spend 1 power point daily or its body decomposes.

monsters.name: Giant
monsters.desc: Huge, ugly, surly humanoids with a taste for human flesh. This is a fully-grown, 8-meter generic giant; giants grow 1D6+6 STR and SIZ every ten years.
monsters.skillsText: Sense 60%, Spot 40%, Throw 35%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Uses enormous clubs (10 + damage-modifier dice HP) or tree trunks, specializing in sweep attacks. Some powerful or older giants use magic or sorcery.

monsters.name: Griffin
monsters.desc: A chimerical flying predator: the body and hindquarters of a lion with the head, forelegs, and wings of an eagle. Traditionally nests on mountaintops.
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 30%, Fly 100%, Listen 50%, Sense 65%, Spot 75%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Attacks with both claws simultaneously and bites 5 DEX ranks later.

monsters.name: Halfling
monsters.desc: Small, peaceful, civilized human-like beings fond of eating, pipe-smoking, and drinking; live in rural communities, often barefoot.
monsters.attacksText: Short Sword 35%, 1D6+1+dm; Sling 35%, 1D8+½dm; Thrown Rock 50%, 1D4 (no damage modifier)
monsters.skillsText: Appraise 35%, Bargain 35%, Craft (farming) 75%, Dodge 60%, Drive (wagon) 45%, Grapple 35%, Hide 65%, Knowledge (Halfling-lore) 35%, Language (Halfling) 75%, Language (Human) 65%, Listen 65%, Sense 45%, Spot 50%, Throw 50%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Expert at throwing rocks — ignore the negative damage modifier for thrown rocks. Traditionally shun magic; fewer still use sorcery.

monsters.name: Minotaur
monsters.desc: Bull-headed, hoofed humanoids; surly and violent, with little civilization of their own, dwelling in ruins or the wild. Some speak; others are bestial.
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 40%, Listen 35%, Sense 30%, Spot 35%, Track 55%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Can use head butt or a weapon in a round, not both unless capable of two attacks. If wounded or scoring a special success, goes berserk for 24−CON turns (as the Fury sorcery spell); can shake it off with a successful INT×1 roll, then is fatigued. Rarely knows magic.

monsters.name: Mummy
monsters.desc: An undead creature formed from a preserved corpse, animated by curse or necromancy, often guarding a temple or tomb. Fire is unusually effective against them.
monsters.skillsText: Language (ancient tongue) 90%, Listen 50%, Sense 45%, Spot 50%, Stealth 50%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Two fist attacks a round; if both hit, grapples and chokes next round. It is twice as easy to ignite a mummy and its fires are harder to extinguish. May remember sorcery from its former life — a sorcerer-mummy might know Brazier of Power (4), Gift of the Earth (4), Pox (1), Sorcerer’s Talons (2).

monsters.name: Orc
monsters.desc: Savage, bestial humanoids who despise humans, elves, and dwarves; grayish skin, fangs, pointed ears. Prefer darkness; enslave and cannibalize captives.
monsters.attacksText: Scimitar 35%, 1D8+1+dm; Composite Bow 35%, 1D8+1+½dm; Short Spear 35%, 1D6+1+dm; Short Spear (thrown) 35%, 1D6+1+½dm; Spiked Shield 35%, 1D3+dm
monsters.skillsText: Climb 55%, Dodge 40%, Hide 35%, Knowledge (Orc-lore) 35%, Language (Human) 25%, Language (Orcish) 60%, Listen 50%, Ride (wolf) 50%, Sense 35%, Spot 45%, Stealth 40%, Track 30%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Sorcery is orc society’s most fearsome power; sorcerer-orcs (POW 16+) often lead as priests, knowing spells like Cloak of Night (2), Pox (1), Rat’s Vision (1), Sorcerer’s Razor (1), Sorcerer’s Speed (2), Ward (3). "Greater" orcs are larger (STR 5D6, CON 3D6+3, SIZ 3D6+6); "lesser" orcs are weaker (STR 3D6, SIZ 2D6).

monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.desc: Animated bones created or summoned by magic or an ancient curse, usually guarding treasure or a tomb. Move at their living speed but cannot swim, and never tire.
monsters.attacksText: Broadsword 55%, 1D8+1+dm; Self Bow 50%, 1D6+1+½dm; Large Round Shield 55%, 1D4+dm
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 40%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: No CON — hit points equal SIZ. Immune to bleeding/impaling special effects and takes no damage at all from thrusting weapons (unless a special/critical, in which case damage applies but not the secondary effect). Any blow has a chance of shattering the skeleton outright equal to the damage done ×4%, in addition to normal HP loss.

monsters.name: Troll
monsters.desc: Huge, flesh-eating humanoids with greenish-black hide and long claws; dwell in caves, mountains, or under bridges, nocturnal and shunning sunlight. Trollwives are smaller but smarter and faster.
monsters.attacksText: Tree Trunk Club 45%, 1D10+2+dm; Claw 50%, 1D6+dm; Grapple 50%, special
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 35%, Sense 55%, Spot 55%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Regenerates 1D3 hit points per combat round (1 per wounded location if using hit locations) unless dead, in sunlight, or wounded by fire. Natural Super Sense (Night Vision) at half POW (round up). Its club is like a giant’s (10 + damage-modifier dice HP) and it cannot parry the round it uses club-then-claw. Trollwives are usually sorcery-using witches (Curse of Sorcery (4), Pox (1), Undo Sorcery (2), Witch Sight (3)).

monsters.name: Unicorn
monsters.desc: A horse-like magical animal with a single straight horn; solitary, peaceful, and highly sensitive to magic. Trusting of maidenly humans and elves.
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 35%, Hide 65%, Insight 50%, Jump 90%, Listen 70%, Sense 80%, Spot 75%, Stealth 50%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Can heal wounds by touch with its horn (1 power point per HP restored; 6+ points reattaches a severed limb). Can cure poison/disease-drained characteristics at a cost of 1 permanent POW per point cured. Detects poison by touching it with its horn; a cup made from the horn shatters if poisoned.

monsters.name: Vampire
monsters.desc: Undead who survive by drinking blood, created when a victim shares blood with a vampire and dies. Some retain their intelligence and move through society unnoticed; others are little more than beasts.
monsters.attacksText: Bite 50%, 1D4+½dm + Blood Drain; Claw 50%, 1D4+dm + Chill Touch; Hypnotic Gaze, POW vs. POW, special; Grapple 75%, special
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 50%, Etiquette 50%, Fly 90%, Hide 70%, Insight 60%, Jump 75%, Knowledge (History) 75%, Language (ancient) 75%, Language (modern) 50%, Listen 60%, Persuade 60%, Sense 75%, Spot 75%, Stealth 80%, Track 75%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: One bite and two claws a round (or one claw and a hypnotic gaze); grapples and drains blood after both claws and a bite connect. Blood Drain siphons 1D6 STR or power points a round (CON once STR is gone; 0 CON kills), converted to the vampire’s own power points (max = its CON) — a vampire has no POW of its own. Chill Touch drains 1D3 power points a round via a power point resistance roll after a claw hit. Hypnotic Gaze (current power points vs. target POW) forces simple commands. Night Sight combines Dark/Infrared/Night Vision at half INT. Regenerates 1D3 HP/round unless in sunlight or near a holy symbol. May also command lesser undead/animals (Legions of the Night), turn to mist, shape-shift into wolf/bat/rat-swarm, or cast double the normal human capacity of magic/sorcery spells.

abilities.name: Weaknesses
abilities.text: Loses 1D6 power points daily (Difficult rolls at 1-2 left); takes 1 damage/round in direct sunlight and cannot regenerate, shape-change, mist, or gaze while in it; double damage from fire; decapitation is final; holy symbols and holy water (acid, 1D4/round) harm it; loses 3D6 power points/day without 4+ hours in native earth; a wooden stake through the heart (1D3+dm, 6 HP, base 15%) disintegrates it.

monsters.name: Werewolf
monsters.desc: A shape-changer between human, hybrid, and wolf forms (lycanthropy), sometimes voluntary, sometimes tied to the full moon. In human form it has ordinary human characteristics.
monsters.attacksText: Hybrid: Bite 50%, 1D4+½dm; Claws 65%, 1D6+dm. Wolf: Bite 65%, 1D8+½dm; Claws 45%, 1D6+dm
monsters.skillsText: Climb 75%, Dodge 65%, Hide 60%, Jump 80%, Listen 70%, Sense 90%, Spot 70%, Track 90%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Immune to all damage but magic, fire, and silver — other attacks simply bounce off. Regenerates 1 HP/round (not damage from silver). Can shift between human, hybrid, and wolf forms in 5 DEX ranks at no power point cost. Makes one bite and two claw attacks a round in any form.

monsters.name: Zombie
monsters.desc: An animated corpse raised by necromancy, voodoo, demonic possession, or toxins; thirsts for flesh, usually mute, not very bright, and easily fooled.
monsters.attacksText: Bite 30%, 1D3+½dm; Claw 25%, 1D3+dm; Grapple 35%, special; Large Club 35%, 1D8+1+dm
monsters.skillsText: Sense 50%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Weapon skill equals DEX×5; never dodges or parries. Most slashing/crushing/impaling weapons do only half damage; fire does full damage. Some types can only be finished by a special/critical hit to the head. Some are infectious — a successful bite turns the victim in a number of turns equal to their CON.

monsters.name: Angel
monsters.desc: A holy being, emissary of a divine power, serving as messenger, guardian, soldier, or mentor. This example is a winged humanoid with a breastplate and flaming sword.
monsters.attacksText: Flaming Broad Sword 200%, 1D8+1+dm +2D6 fire; Holy Fire 100%, 10D6 fire; Voice of Heaven 100%, special
monsters.skillsText: Command 100%, Dodge 100%, Flight 100%, Insight 75%, Knowledge (any) 100%, Language (any) 100%, Sense 90%, Spot 90%, Teach 90%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Divine Radiance grants 10-pt armor vs. any damage. Flight at levels equal to POW, free. Healing Touch restores HP at 1 per power point and can cure any infirmity for 1 permanent POW each. Holy Fire is a 3m-square flame strike doing 10D6 (10 power points, once/day). Invisibility at half POW in levels for 3 power points. Voice of Heaven stuns a 10m radius (POW vs. POW) for 3 power points. May know magic (Countermagic, Dispel, Enhance, Light, Speak to Mind, Teleport, all at 100%) or superpowers; rarely sorcery, never mutation.

monsters.name: Demon, Greater
monsters.desc: An infernal being summoned or manifest for terrible purpose; may be bestial or urbane and persuasive. This represents a combat-oriented, clawed and horned demon.
monsters.attacksText: Great Sword (one-handed) 150%, 2D8+dm +2D6 flame; Whip 90%, 1D3−1+½dm entangle +1D6 fire; Flame Breath 100%, 6D6 fire; Claws 150%, 1D6+dm; Grapple 150%, special
monsters.skillsText: Climb 90%, Dodge 75%, Fly 100%, Jump 75%, Sense 75%, Spot 75%, Throw 75%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Aura of Terror (POW vs. POW in a POW-meter radius, 1 power point) inflicts fear making all actions Difficult. Blight taints the land within POW×100m over 30−POW days. Flame Breath is a 3m-square, 6D6 area attack at CON meters range for 6 power points, burning three extra rounds. Flies tirelessly. Regenerates 1D6 HP/round for free. Sheath of Smoke and Fire burns anyone within 2m for 1D6/round for 1 power point. May have one or more Chaotic Features.

monsters.name: Demon, Lesser
monsters.desc: A smaller demon summoned by a sorcerer or sent as an emissary; a grotesque, emaciated, gargoyle-like creature. Not cowardly, but prefers non-combat means.
monsters.skillsText: Bargain 55%, Climb 65%, Dodge 50%, Fast Talk 40%, Fly 75%, Hide 45%, Knowledge (Region: Hell) 35%, Listen 40%, Sense 35%, Spot 50%, Stealth 35%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Two claw attacks a round; grapples and bites next round if both hit. May know a few sorcery spells if POW is high enough — common ones are Curse of Sorcery (4), Flames of the Sun (4), Midnight (1), Pox (1). May have a Chaotic Feature.

monsters.name: Elemental, Air
monsters.desc: Floating, transparent, beautiful humanoid spirits of surpassing beauty surrounded by a whirlwind, mischievous with a short attention span. Often called sylphs.
monsters.attacksText: Scouring Wind 50%, 1D10 (knockback, range POW in meters)
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 75%, Fly 100%, Language (summoner’s) 100%, Listen 75%, Science (Meteorology) 100%, Sense 75%, Spot 75%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Hit points are CON+SIZ, not averaged; disappears at 0 HP or 0 power points, no natural healing. Casts Lift and Lightning at POW×3%; knows the sorcery spell Wings of the Sky (4) for free; has ¼ POW (round up) in levels of Energy Control/Projection (Wind). Can destroy a fire elemental of equal strength at the cost of its own life, supply breathable air (1 HP/round), and turn invisible for 1 power point.

monsters.name: Elemental, Earth
monsters.desc: Thick-bodied humanoid forms of stone, earth, and minerals with mossy hair or beards; slow-witted, grumpy, but obedient. Often called gnomes.
monsters.skillsText: Appraise 50%, Craft (Blacksmithing) 75%, Language (summoner’s) 25%, Science (Metallurgy) 100%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Hit points are CON+SIZ, not averaged. Casts Dull and Wall at POW×3%; knows Gift of the Earth (4) for free; has ¼ POW (round up) in levels of Barrier. Can destroy an air elemental of equal strength at the cost of its own life, burrow through earth (carrying a willing character), has a chance of breaking metal weapons that strike it, and senses precious metals/underground items within INT×100 meters.

monsters.name: Elemental, Fire
monsters.desc: Four-legged reptiles made of fiery plasma; irritable, quick-tempered, scorching the ground and smoking as they speak. Often called salamanders.
monsters.attacksText: Flame Breath 50%, 1D10/round fire (range POW in meters); Grapple 50%, special + 1D6/round fire
monsters.skillsText: Demolition 75%, Dodge 50%, Language (summoner’s) 50%, Listen 50%, Sense 50%, Spot 50%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Hit points are CON+SIZ, not averaged. Casts Flame and Resistance at POW×3%; knows Flames of the Sun (4) for free; has ¼ POW (round up) in levels of Energy Control/Projection (Heat). Can destroy a water elemental of equal strength at the cost of its own life, and ignites flammable material by touch.

monsters.name: Elemental, Water
monsters.desc: Beautiful, translucent aquatic humanoid females, greenish-blue, alluring, leaving wet footprints and dripping constantly. Often called undines.
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 75%, Language (summoner’s) 75%, Navigate 100%, Science (Oceanography) 100%, Sense 50%, Spot 50%, Swim 100%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Hit points are CON+SIZ, not averaged. Casts Heal and Unseal at POW×3%; knows Bounty of the Sea (4) for free; has ¼ POW (round up) in levels of Drain and Super Movement (Water Walking). Can destroy an earth elemental of equal strength at the cost of its own life. Drowns a touched target (Easy attacks thereafter, costs the elemental HP equal to damage dealt); turns invisible underwater for 1 power point; senses items within its home water within INT×100 meters.

monsters.name: Alien, Grey
monsters.desc: Frail, emotionless beings who visit Earth for research and experimentation, relying on sophisticated technology to immobilize captive subjects.
monsters.skillsText: Dodge 40%, Fine Manipulation 75%, First Aid 75%, Hide 60%, Knowledge (Human Culture) 55%, Knowledge (Region: Milky Way) 85%, Language (Area) 20%, Language (Zeta Reticulan) 100%, Listen 55%, Medicine 100%, Navigate 70%, Pilot (UFO) 80%, Repair (Quantum) 50%, Science (Astronomy) 75%, Science (Planetology) 95%, Science (Zoology) 50%, Sense 60%, Spot 50%, Stealth 50%, Technical Skill (UFO Sensors) 50%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Uses psychic powers at POW×2% or higher: Emotion Control, Mind Control, Mind Shield, Telekinesis, Telepathy.

monsters.name: Alien, Xenomorph
monsters.desc: Ravenous, vaguely insectile aliens that devour any living being encountered; reproduce by implanting eggs in hosts. A brood queen is said to lead each hive.
monsters.armorNote: carapace, spews acidic blood when wounded
monsters.attacksText: Claw 50%, 1D6+dm; Bite 35%, 1D6+dm; Tail Lash 35%, 1D4+dm; Grapple 35%, special
monsters.skillsText: Climb 75%, Dodge 50%, Hide 60%, Jump 50%, Listen 35%, Sense 50%, Spot 35%, Stealth 50%, Track 75%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Two claw attacks then a bite 5 DEX ranks later (substitutes tail lash when appropriate); grapples and bites if both claws hit. Blood sprays as corrosive acid for 1D6+2 rounds when wounded — anyone within 1m must make a Luck roll or take 1D3 acid damage, which continues eating through armor each round.

monsters.name: Blob
monsters.desc: A grotesque mass of slimy, semi-translucent protoplasm, constantly extending pseudopods and engulfing victims to digest them alive. Can compact itself through tight spaces.
monsters.skillsText: Climb 50%, Hide 25%, Sense 25%, Stealth 25%, Track 25%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: No armor, but fire/electrical attacks do only half damage and firearms only 1 point. Engulfing applies its damage modifier each round thereafter (1D3−1 if hit locations aren’t used); escaping takes a Difficult Effort roll. Regenerates 1 HP/round until full.

monsters.name: Robot, Giant
monsters.desc: Built by a secret government agency to fight alien creatures and giant monsters; armored, heavily armed, and idolized despite the collateral damage it causes.
monsters.attacksText: Energy Cannon 100%, 10D6; Missile Pod 100%, 8D6+8 (+knockback); Energy Sword 75%, 4D10+dm; Fist 75%, 1D6+dm; Kick 75%, 1D6+dm (knockback); Stomp 75%, 2D6+dm; Grapple 75%, special
monsters.skillsText: Artillery 75%, Dodge 40%, Fine Manipulation 35%, Fly (Internal Rockets) 90%, Jump 55%, Knowledge (Kaiju) 50%, Language (English) 30%, Language (Japanese) 75%, Listen 65%, Martial Arts 40%, Navigate 50%, Repair (Mechanical) 55%, Spot 65%, Throw 55%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: 188 HP includes +100 from Extra Hit Points. Built from superpowers: Absorption (Electric) 20; Adaptation (High Pressure, Vacuum, always-on) 30; Armor (Heat, Kinetic, Radiation) 30 each; Energy Projection (Kinetic) 10; Extra Energy +200; Extra Hit Points +100; Flight 30; Resistance (Radiation, Sound) 10 each; Super Sense (5 types) 10 each; Super Skill 15 (Artillery +60%, Brawl +40%, Fly +60%, Navigate +20%, Repair +20%, Spot +40%).

monsters.name: Robot, Killer
monsters.desc: A pitiless, resourceful robot of many possible origins — military gone rogue, murderous household unit, or an assassin from elsewhere in time or space.
monsters.attacksText: Plasma Rifle 80%, 2D10+4; Assault Rifle 80%, 2D6+2; Automatic Shotgun 80%, 4D6/2D6/1D6; Heavy Pistol 80%, 1D10+2; Fist 80%, 1D3+dm
monsters.skillsText: Artillery 80%, Brawl 80%, Climb 50%, Demolition 50%, Dodge 40%, Drive (Motorcycle) 75%, Drive (Truck) 60%, Grapple 80%, Jump 50%, Knowledge (Future History) 65%, Knowledge (Region: Local) 50%, Language (Binary) 100%, Language (Local) 60%, Listen 65%, Pilot (Helicopter) 50%, Repair (Electronics) 75%, Repair (Mechanical) 95%, Spot 75%, Strategy 40%, Throw 55%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Equipped for its era/setting. Usually has a few Super Sense superpowers (Infrared Vision, Super Hearing, Super Vision, Ultrasonic Hearing) at 5 each, free to use. Some can shape-change, stretch, or carry integral weapons (claws, blades, laser eyes, firearms).

monsters.name: Robot, Utility
monsters.desc: A humble, humble servant robot engineered to aid humans with mechanical, electrical, diplomatic, or personal-assistance work; programmed to avoid harming living beings.
monsters.skillsText: Diplomacy package: Appraise 85%, Bargain 55%, Etiquette 95%, Fast Talk 75%, Heavy Machine (Binary Loadlifter) 50%, Hide 25%, Insight 35%, Knowledge (Alien Cultures) 75%, Knowledge (Linguistics) 100%, Language (all known) 95%, Listen 55%, Persuade 45%, Teach 60%. Technical package: Fine Manipulation 95%, Heavy Machine (Spaceport Systems) 95%, Hide 35%, Language (Galactic Common, cannot speak) 50%, Language (Machine) 100%, Listen 50%, Pilot (Starfighter) 50%, Repair (Electronic) 95%, Repair (Mechanical) 95%, Repair (Quantum) 75%, Spot 50%, Technical Skill (Computer Use) 100%.

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Strict programming against harming sentients, though some are less strict and may act in self-defense. Has built-in tools (welders, electric dischargers) usable as weapons.

monsters.name: Cave Dweller
monsters.desc: A primitive human focused on survival for self, family, and tribe; barely uses tools, migrates with the seasons, and venerates the spirits of weather and prey.
monsters.attacksText: Short Spear 50%, 1D6+1+dm; Short Spear (thrown) 50%, 1D6+1+½dm; Light Club 50%, 1D6+dm; Rock (thrown) 50%, 1D2+½dm; Grapple 50%, special
monsters.skillsText: Brawl 50%, Climb 60%, Craft (Wood Carving) 25%, Dodge 35%, Hide 35%, Jump 50%, Language (Own) 40%, Listen 55%, Sense 50%, Spot 65%, Stealth 30%, Throw 50%, Track 40%

abilities.name: Powers
abilities.text: Rarely has powers, though a tribal shaman may have a few magic spells or psychic abilities if POW is high enough.

monsters.name: Criminal Mastermind
